name: Revo2
summary: Revo2 is BrainCo's bionic dexterous hand for robot integration and manipulation research. Its six active joints produce 11 total degrees of freedom, including separately controlled thumb flexion and lateral movement. The manufacturer lists a 383 g mass excluding the wrist, programmable gestures and closed-loop position, speed and current control. SDK resources support Linux, Windows and ROS workflows. Basic models provide RS485 and CAN FD, while advanced and tactile versions add EtherCAT. Multidimensional fingertip sensing is specific to the tactile configuration.
